checkin_types_scope_team_constraint.name: checkin_types_scope_team_constraint
checkin_types_scope_team_constraint.value:
(
				("checkin_types"."scope" = 'team' AND "checkin_types"."team_id" IS NOT NULL)
				OR
				("checkin_types"."scope" = 'organization' AND "checkin_types"."team_id" IS NULL)
			)

wa_manual_send_idempotency_completion_ch.name: wa_manual_send_idempotency_completion_check
wa_manual_send_idempotency_completion_ch.value: (status = 'processing' AND message_id IS NULL AND outbox_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'completed' AND message_id IS NOT NULL AND outbox_id IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)

assignment_submissions_task_or_deliverab.name: assignment_submissions_task_or_deliverable
assignment_submissions_task_or_deliverab.value: (task_id IS NOT NULL AND deliverable_id IS NULL) OR (task_id IS NULL AND deliverable_id IS NOT NULL)

crews_org_user_active_unique.name: crews_org_user_active_unique

crews_org_phone_idx.name: crews_org_phone_idx

expense_assignments_single_target.name: expense_assignments_single_target
expense_assignments_single_target.value: (booking_id IS NOT NULL AND shoot_id IS NULL AND crew_id IS NULL) OR (booking_id IS NULL AND shoot_id IS NOT NULL AND crew_id IS NULL) OR (booking_id IS NULL AND shoot_id IS NULL AND crew_id IS NOT NULL)

invoice_line_items_itemized_check.name: invoice_line_items_itemized_check
invoice_line_items_itemized_check.value: CASE WHEN type IN ('item', 'service') THEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity > 0 AND unit_price IS NOT NULL AND unit_price >= 0 AND amount = quantity * unit_price ELSE TRUE END

invoice_line_items_lump_sum_check.name: invoice_line_items_lump_sum_check
invoice_line_items_lump_sum_check.value: CASE WHEN type IN ('milestone', 'expense') THEN quantity IS NULL AND unit_price IS NULL AND amount >= 0 ELSE TRUE END

invoices_active_payment_schedule_idx.name: invoices_active_payment_schedule_idx
invoices_active_payment_schedule_idx.where: payment_schedule_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

invoices_amounts_non_negative.name: invoices_amounts_non_negative
invoices_amounts_non_negative.value: subtotal >= 0 AND tax_amount >= 0 AND discount_amount >= 0 AND total_amount >= 0

payment_idempotency_completion_check.name: payment_idempotency_completion_check
payment_idempotency_completion_check.value: (status = 'processing' AND result_resource_id IS NULL AND result_payload IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'completed' AND result_resource_id IS NOT NULL AND result_payload IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)

receipts_active_received_amount_idx.name: receipts_active_received_amount_idx
receipts_active_received_amount_idx.where: received_amount_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

submission_feedback_rating_range.name: submission_feedback_rating_range
submission_feedback_rating_range.value: rating IS NULL OR (rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5)
